title: Smelly wind and poo - upset tummy?

posts.body:
Sophie has suddenly started smelling when she passes wind or has a poo.  It's a kind of eggy smell (TMI).  Mike is convinced she's raiding the fridge in the evenings when we don't notice  🙃
Anyway, as I breastfeed only and haven't changed my diet, do you think this could be a sign of an upset tummy?  She's bright in herself, feeding well and playing.
It has been happening for two days now and I can't find anything about a pongy baby on the net  😇
Anyone else found this happen?

yes charlie stinks !!
and he does REALLY long farts
its all normal just like me your second baby is a bit stinkier, maybe its a breastfed thing ? 😐
i dont mind the farting at least he never projectile vomits like my 1st did
anyway the wind comes out is good

Jack is 3 weeks old, breastfed and his farting and pooing is...well...chemical to say the least....I thought someone had thrown in a tear gas bomb! ( Certainly made my eyes water )
Perfectly normal...  🙂
subjects like this make me chuckle!  I love farts!!! Chris smells and hes 44!  and he knows better!

Oh my god, yes hun - completely normal as far as i can tell.  Lolly never really smelt that bad? 🤔   But Jake. . . different story. . . he stank from day 1! lol.  I had never smelt such awful baby farts.  I was convinced someone was just blaming him for their smellyness, but nope, it was definitely all him! Sttttinnnnky! 😉  hehe

[QUOTE FROM ANOTHER POST]
Lucy said:
subjects like this make me chuckle!  I love farts!!! Chris smells and hes 44!  and he knows better!
[/QUOTE]
My God, I don't think I've ever heard a woman say she loves farts!! Lucy!!!! 😀 you crack me up@!!!
Aaralyn was (and is still) very gassy... must be something with breastfed babies maybe?  She would embarrass me as a tiny infant in public and let a really loud one fly and no one would ever think it came from such a tiny little thing so of course who did they look at? 😊
She lets really long ones still and cracks us both up LOL... I guess we're both long winded, just in different ways... HAHAHAHAHA 😀

Funnily enough, she's not smelling anymore now. It lasted about 2-3 days and has gone. It must have been something I ate but heaven knows what  🤔
She does do the loudest farts too!!  I've blamed Mike a few times and Jasmine couldn't believe that such a small thing made so much noise  😲
Also, she seems to go on and on forever at times, it just goes pop, pop, pop, pop, pop, pop....I can't believe such a tiny person can have that much wind without taking off  😲
I agree though, any way it comes out is great!  😀
This thread did make me laugh - you lot are so funny  😀
